next.reason: §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.2 (added by Amendment 1, X3.23a-1989; Errata C95) prints one format: the required word FUNCTION, "function-name-1", an optional parenthesized list of one or more argument-1, and an optional reference-modifier. §2023:8.4.3.2.2 widens it: FUNCTION is in brackets (§2023:8.4.3.2.3 SR2: "the word FUNCTION may be omitted from the function-identifier; otherwise the word FUNCTION is required"); the name is one of "function-pointer-name-1", "function-prototype-name-1" or "intrinsic-function-name-1" where 1985 has only an intrinsic function-name; each argument position may be the word "OMITTED"; and the item inside the parentheses is bracketed, so the list may be empty (the NOTE at §2023:8.4.3.2.3 SR6 writes FUNCTION RANDOM ()). The reference-modifier leaves this format: 2023 carries it as identifier Format 3, "identifier-1 reference-modifier-1" (§2023:8.4.3.1.2), whose identifier-1 may be a function-identifier, with the modifier's own format at §2023:8.4.3.3.2 ("leftmost-position" : length). Every function-identifier 1985 accepts is still accepted; 2023 accepts forms 1985 refuses.
